name: ssr-sveltekit
description: SvelteKit file-routed SSR reference app for @iris-ui-kit/svelte

scripts.test: vitest run --config vitest.ssr.config.ts && vitest run --config vitest.hydrate.config.ts && node --test test/production-routes.node.mjs
scripts.lint: eslint src test svelte.config.js vite.config.ts vitest.ssr.config.ts vitest.hydrate.config.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src test svelte.config.js vite.config.ts vitest.ssr.config.ts vitest.hydrate.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json
